singleSourceOfTruth.rule: K3 shape fields below must equal the engineering preset; tests/regression/test_k3_manifest_consistency.js enforces this. Change the preset first, then regenerate.
singleSourceOfTruth.DeepSeek-V4-Pro: teams/model/inputs/formal_model_manifests.json#/models/2/shape (reported fields from model_profiles.json plus explicit ASSUMPTION fields)
singleSourceOfTruth.GLM-5.2: teams/model/inputs/formal_model_manifests.json#/models/1/shape (public HF config.json fields plus explicit ASSUMPTION fields for the deployment layout)

scope.note: This is a reproducible architecture planning manifest, not a vendor-certified deployment manifest.

stateConfig.kvLayout: FlashMLA FP8: 512 FP8 latent + 4 FP32 scales + 64 BF16 RoPE (integration/detailed/k3_rdma_final_tuning_model.js OPT.kvCache=fp8)

blockers: Vendor/config verification not supplied; shape is the repository engineering preset.
Config fields are taken from the public HF config.json; the deployment layout (FP8 KV cache, index-key bytes, TP mapping, collectives per layer) is an explicit ASSUMPTION and not vendor-confirmed.

bytesPerParam.basis: ASSUMPTION: FP8 checkpoint as published (attention, indexer, dense FFN, shared and routed experts 1 B; router and LM head BF16 2 B); the 128x128 FP32 block scales (0.02%) are ignored; the embedding is a row lookup and is not counted

kvBytesPerTokenPerLayer.basis: ASSUMPTION: FlashMLA FP8 layout (512 FP8 latent + 4 FP32 scales + 64 BF16 RoPE), same as K3 and DeepSeek-V4-Pro; the HF reference caches BF16

indexKeyBytesPerToken.basis: ASSUMPTION: FP8 128-dim index key + FP32 scale per token, cached only in "full" indexer layers (shared layers have no indexer)

sparseAttention.value: every layer reads indexerTopK KV entries; full layers run their own indexer over the whole context, shared layers reuse the previous full layer's top-k
sparseAttention.basis: modeling_glm_moe_dsa.py: indexer_types[layer] == "shared" sets indexer = None and reuses prev_topk_indices; index_skip_topk_offset is not read by the modeling code

parallelism.value: context and every expert (dense FFN, shared and routed) sharded over the TP ranks; no expert parallelism, no all-to-all
parallelism.basis: DEPLOYMENT_DECISION (2026-09-25): FFN/MoE of all three models is deployed TP-only, as for K3; the FFN/MoE output is one TP all-reduce per layer

collectivesPerLayer.basis: ASSUMPTION: indexer top-k merge (full layers only), sparse-attention LSE merge, attention output all-reduce, FFN/MoE output all-reduce; same basis as DeepSeek-V4-Pro

collectiveMessageBytes.value: 2 x hidden x 2 B per rank
collectiveMessageBytes.basis: ASSUMPTION: ring all-reduce of one BF16 hidden vector

mtp.basis: MTP / speculative decode is not in the TPS/usr metric (num_nextn_predict_layers = 1 is counted in the 753B total only)

blockers: Vendor/config verification not supplied; the shape block mixes reported fields with explicit ASSUMPTION fields.

denseLayers.basis: ASSUMPTION: DeepSeek-V3 first_k_dense_replace = 3; the other 58 layers are MoE

vocab.basis: ASSUMPTION: DeepSeek-V3 vocabulary; untied embedding and LM head

mla.basis: ASSUMPTION: DeepSeek-V3 MLA dimensions; decode uses the absorbed form (QK over 512+64, PV over 512 per head)

indexer.basis: ASSUMPTION: DeepSeek-V3.2 lightning indexer (FP8 128-dim key + FP32 scale per token per layer); q from the q-LoRA latent; scoring runs on the H tensor engines

expertHidden.basis: ASSUMPTION: the reported 49B active and 1.6T total cannot both hold with the other ASSUMPTION fields. The point estimate is solved from the reported 49B active (embedding included; the implied total is recorded against 1600B); the variant expertHiddenFromTotal is solved from the reported 1600B total, and TPS/usr is reported as the range of both (ADR-0008)

bytesPerParam.basis: ASSUMPTION: FP8 attention, indexer, dense FFN and shared expert; router and LM head BF16 (2 B), aligned with the GLM-5.2 FP8 checkpoint; routed experts FP4 with one 8-bit scale per 32 weights (same as K3 MXFP4)

kvBytesPerTokenPerLayer.basis: ASSUMPTION: FlashMLA FP8 layout (512 FP8 latent + 4 FP32 scales + 64 BF16 RoPE), same as K3

sparseAttention.value: topK tokens per layer read from the KV cache
sparseAttention.basis: ASSUMPTION: attention reads only indexerTopK entries; the indexer reads every cached index key

parallelism.value: context and every expert (dense FFN, shared and routed) sharded over the TP ranks; no expert parallelism, no all-to-all
parallelism.basis: DEPLOYMENT_DECISION (2026-09-25): FFN/MoE of all three models is deployed TP-only, as for K3; the FFN/MoE output is one TP all-reduce per layer

collectivesPerLayer.basis: ASSUMPTION: indexer top-k merge, sparse-attention LSE merge, attention output all-reduce, FFN/MoE output all-reduce (shared and routed folded); counted on the K3 reference basis, sampling excluded

collectiveMessageBytes.value: 2 x hidden x 2 B per rank
collectiveMessageBytes.basis: ASSUMPTION: ring all-reduce of one BF16 hidden vector

mtp.basis: MTP / speculative decode is not in the TPS/usr metric: the K3 detailed model has none, and the acceptance rate is unmeasured

commonOperatorContract.unknownPolicy: explicit_blocker_only; no residual parameter or silent scaling
